author: TurkishDelite
body:
I present Scorching Dusts. A small simple map where  i place the monuments there to encourage Rushing and Defending to try and make Good gameplay.

2 Teams
Loadout:
 Gold Helmet
 Chainmail Chestplate
 Gold Leggings
 Chainmail Boots
 64 Smooth Sandstone (red sandstone or regular depending on which team),
 16 Wood (Acacia for red, Birch for Blue)
 Bow and 32 Arrows
 Iron Pickaxe Eff 3

Pictures: https://imgur.com/a/SLfCG
Download: Not out yet
YML: http://pastebin.com/BAXi3UB0(Tell me if i stuffed up mapdev's :P)
